source.author: TradingMarkets Editors; Larry Connors methodology
source.checked: Turtle Soup and Plus One false-breakout rules, prior extreme age, protective stop and short-lived reversal management
source.not_claimed: Audited author ledger or ZEL profitability

hypothesis: A completed downside breakout followed by a later completed return inside a frozen prior range may trap breakout sellers; contribution outside K/S is unmeasured.

rules.setup: Current completed close strictly below prior20 low; prior20 high/low fixed excluding setup. All21 bars contiguous and on-time. Reference low last occurred>=4 bars before setup.
rules.recovery: A later completed bar within3 bars closes strictly above frozen low and strictly below frozen midpoint. Wick recovery alone never signals. Crossing midpoint cancels late entry.
rules.initial_stop: Minimum low from setup through recovery, inclusive; no tick padding/no ATR substitution.
rules.signal: One signal per consumed reference-low timestamp; signal at recovery available_ts=close; no backdated delayed observation.
rules.entry: Immediate next contiguous30m open only, and frozen low < actual entry < midpoint and entry > stop.
rules.take_profit: First completed held close>=frozen midpoint requests next open exit; no intrabar favorable fill.
rules.failure_exit: First completed held close<frozen low requests next open exit; hard stop always checked first.
rules.time_exit: After12 held complete bars, next contiguous open; missing next open stays unresolved.
rules.reentry: Each reference-low timestamp consumed on setup, including expired/late recoveries. New aged reference required.
rules.same_bar: Existing engine stop-first; close target cannot override touched stop.
rules.gaps: Before entry reset setup/history; gap after entry unresolved and retains occupancy to window end.
rules.cost: Exact common frozen positive round-trip per-symbol cost; 1x/2x same fills. Historical funding/latency are unverified reference assumptions.

all_numeric_strategy_choices: Internal fixed development assumptions. No search or economic evaluation used to select numbers; not SSOT risk/promotion thresholds.

differences.range_fade__donor_state_machine_v2: Completed close below aged frozen low THEN later close inside; no5m EMA-flat/ATR reclaim tolerance/VWAP target;30m geometric extreme stop and fixed midpoint close exit.
differences.rbreaker_like_30m_round1_v2: Multi-bar completed close failure required, unlike same-bar low<rolling low<close directional reclaim; no0.9ATR/1.8R template.
differences.rsi_swing_fail_30m_round1_v2: No RSI oscillator, oversold state, or RSI-turn gate; strictly price close failure/recovery.
differences.liquidity_sweep_15m_daily_soup_intraday_: Not daily20-session PIT tick stop-order model:30m closed-bar research adaptation; requires later close recovery and next-open fill; no fabricated tick.

input_contract.availability: Only completed on-time bars; any late bar resets warmup/setup; no forward fill
